news.title: Oceania’s next generation ready for FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup qualifiers
news.lede: The next generation of women’s football talent in Oceania will take centre stage in Honiara over the next fortnight, with eight nations set to compete for the OFC U-16 Women’s Championship 2026 and a coveted pathway towards next year’s FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup in Morocco. The tournament kicks off on Sunday September 6, with Cook Islands, Fiji, New Caledonia, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea, Samoa, Solomon Islands, Tonga and New Caledonia all eyeing continental success. Main photo: Captains call before the 2026 OFC U-16 Women’s Championship. Photo credit: OFC Media / Phototek.

news.title: “They Put Qatar’s Clothes on Him at the Moment of World Cup Victory”... Football Has Become Nothing More Than a Money Game [Book]
news.lede: The moment Lionel Messi had dreamed of all his life was quite different from what we had imagined. At the awards ceremony at Lusail Stadium in Qatar in 2022, Argentina’s sky-blue stripes were covered by a black outer garment just before he lifted the World Cup trophy. It was a traditional Arab robe called a bisht, which Qatar’s emir personally draped over Messi’s shoulders. The convention that the captain of the winning team should lift the trophy wearing only his national team jersey was broken.

news.title: What comes next for Messi after a cruel summer?
news.lede: The 2026 World Cup ended with Argentina losing the final to Spain. Soon after, Lionel Messi returned to Rosario, where he suffered a far greater loss with the death of his father, Jorge. Now, at 39, Messi's future in football is suddenly less certain. A recent report by The Athletic has shed more light on what Messi has been going through since Argentina's 1-0 defeat by Spain in the World Cup final.

news.title: PREVIEW: Junior Football Ferns to be tested at FIFA U-20 Women’s World Cup
news.lede: New Zealand’s Junior Football Ferns face a tough test when they represent their country at the FIFA U-20 Women’s World Cup, starting in Poland this weekend. The cities of Łódź, Katowice, Sosnowiec, and Bielsko-Biała will share the 24-team tournament. New Zealand will be represented for the tenth time. The top two teams in each group and the best four third-placed teams will advance to the knockout rounds, but the Junior Football Ferns will have quite the task in an unforgiving Group D.

news.title: Japan national football team: the full squad and key players after nine summer moves
news.lede: Japan took 26 players to the 2026 World Cup and nine of them have changed clubs since. Here is the current squad with caps, goals and corrected clubs, plus the captain who retired without kicking a ball at the tournament. Japan are coached by Hajime Moriyasu, ranked 17th in the world by FIFA as of 20 July 2026, and took 26 players to the 2026 World Cup. Ten of those 26 entries have since moved.

news.title: Netherlands national football team: the full squad and key players Xavi has inherited
news.lede: Xavi Hernandez took over the Netherlands in August and names his first squad this month. Here is the group he inherits, with caps, goals and current clubs, and why twelve of the 26 play their football in England. The Netherlands have a new manager and an old squad. Xavi Hernandez took the job on 12 August 2026, replacing Ronald Koeman, and has not yet named a group of his own.

news.title: DoorDash Taps Into Football Fandom With Saturday Savings All Fall Long
news.lede: If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission. As summer turns to fall and FIFA World Cup soccer moves into football, DoorDash is staying loyal to sports fans ordering in. Starting Saturday, Sept. 5, the food delivery platform is offering weekly Saturday deals on DoorDash favorites. Order enough, and the weekly discounts turn into monthly prize drawings ranging from DoorDash gift cards to over $750k toward a new house.
